questions.stem: What type of image is formed by a plane mirror?

options.text: Virtual, upright, and the same size as the object
Virtual, inverted, and the same size as the object

questions.explanation: A plane mirror produces a virtual image that is upright, the same size as the object, laterally inverted (left and right swapped), and the same distance behind the mirror as the object is in front.

questions.stem: What is the difference between specular and diffuse reflection?

options.text: Specular reflection occurs on smooth surfaces producing a clear image; diffuse reflection occurs on rough surfaces scattering light
Specular reflection is faster than diffuse reflection
Diffuse reflection only occurs with sound waves
There is no difference; they are the same thing

questions.explanation: Specular reflection occurs when parallel rays hit a smooth surface and reflect as parallel rays, forming a clear image (like a mirror). Diffuse reflection occurs on rough surfaces where parallel rays scatter in many directions, so no clear image is formed.
